cohort: 232 pregnant women aged between 20-45 years presenting at >=37 weeks of gestation were divided into obese (BMI>=30 kg/m^2) and non-obese (BMI 18.5-24.9 kg/m^2) groups.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with significantly higher frequency of instrumental vaginal delivery, cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, fetal macrosomia, poor Apgar score at 5 minutes, and NICU admission.
